### Keeping Watch
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-july-10.html
Passage: Genesis 31:49
Points:
- Parents must remain vigilant because peer pressure can quickly entice young people toward destructive habits.
- Warning signs of substance abuse include sudden mood shifts, physical deterioration, and changing values.
- Effective protection involves getting to know friends and observing shifts in behavior.
- Daily prayer asks the Lord to watch over children and guard them from evil temptations.
